title: MV Need help with attacking an enemy in the overworld

posts.author: weiner_believer
posts.body: So my character picks up a knife at a certain point and I want her to be able to stab at enemies repeatedly by holding down a key in the overworld without actually going into turn based combat. I've already figured out how to make the enemy attack the character but I'm struggling to figure out the opposite effect. I can do a conditional branch "If button is held down".. etc but nothing I've tried is working. Any help would be greatly appreciated.

posts.author: TheAM-Dol
posts.body:
The screen shots you provided, while nice, are functionally useless for us to assist you.
If you could provide an uncropped screen grab of the relevant event pages we can see if it's been set up incorrectly.
While you are at it, I recommend taking a look at this post so that we can better assist you:

Depending on how "actiony" you want to handle the combat, there are a few different ways of handling this.
You could either make touching an enemy lock you into an autorun event that checks for input. This is pretty efficient, but may make combat stiff.
Or you could have a parallel common event checking for input, but you'd need to create a way to detect "hits" and may be performant. It will result in a more responsive feeling combat system though. In this case, I'd probably go with an ABS plugin system, but that adds a lot of complexity. If you are new to RM, I don't recommend it.
